o: Find the midpoint with slow/fast pointers adapted for circularity: advance fast two steps and slow one step while fast hasn't wrapped around to head. When the loop ends, slow sits at the last node of the first half (ceil(n/2) nodes). Cut there: second half starts at slow.next; restore circularity by setting slow.next = head and the original tail's next = second half's head. Example [1,5,7]: halves are [1,5] and [7].
k: Floyd-style slow/fast traversal terminates correctly on circular lists when checking fast.next == head or fast.next.next == head.
After stopping, normalize fast to the true tail, then perform two pointer rewires.

a.i: Advance until fast reaches the node before head; slow lands on the boundary node of the first half; rewire both tails.
s: Loop while fast.next != head and fast.next.next != head, moving slow once and fast twice.
If fast.next != head, advance fast once (even length case).
Set second = slow.next; slow.next = head; fast.next = second; return [head, second].
a.t: O(n) — one traversal with two pointers

a.i: Count the length in one full loop around the circle, then walk ceil(n/2) - 1 steps to the cut point and rewire.
s: Walk from head counting nodes until returning to head.
Walk half = ceil(n/2) - 1 steps to reach the last node of the first half.
Cut and rewire tails exactly as in Approach 1.

c.python:
class Solution:
    def splitCircularLinkedList(self, head):
        n = 1
        cur = head.next
        while cur != head:
            n += 1
            cur = cur.next
        half = (n + 1) // 2
        cur = head
        for _ in range(half - 1):
            cur = cur.next
        tail = head
        for _ in range(n - 1):
            tail = tail.next
        second = cur.next
        cur.next = head
        tail.next = second
        return [head, second]

w: Approach 1 is the elegant one-pass solution interviewers want. Pitfalls: odd vs even lengths (the extra fast advancement), and remembering both lists must remain circular. Verify with n=2 and n=3 by hand. Follow-up: split into k parts.
